name: fields
title: Field presets
description: Presets that pick metacheck's built-in checks for a field of research. No code: only module lists.

general.description: Any empirical paper: metacheck's default report plus ethics approval and open-practice statements, which apply across fields

psychology.description: Psychology: the general checks plus every reported p-value and causal claims about non-randomised designs, common reporting problems in the field

medicine.description: Medicine: the general checks without the FLoRA replication lookup (it covers psychology studies); add the clinical_trials pack for trial registration numbers

open-science.description: Transparency: preregistration, open-practice statements and what the shared repositories actually contain (files, code, data, codebooks, Psych-DS)
